fusions.name: Struck Where Sighted
fusions.desc: A thrust at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 26 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: True Bearing
fusions.desc: Sights along the staff and fixes a stare on the first enemy in line within 8 tiles. It deals 4 damage, with a 40% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Plumb Line
fusions.desc: You sight along the staff before each blow. Your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Watch Kept Long
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
